neighbours.label: the last piece ('D', 'ED') of a rare all-caps acronym that the tokenizer splits
fire: Collectors still prefer the SACD pressing of that old jazz recording to the vinyl.
Few labels released a SACD edition of the symphony after the format declined.
My older player reads SACD layers but cannot handle the newest Blu-ray discs.
Children diagnosed with APECED usually need lifelong care from an endocrinologist.
Researchers traced APECED to mutations in a single gene on chromosome 21.
Workers coated the drill bits by a process known as PECVD at low temperature.
The clinic treats rare immune disorders such as IPEX and CGD in young patients.
Engineers replaced the old panel with a cheaper AMOLED instead of a TFTLCD module.
quiet: Collectors still prefer the CD pressing of that old jazz recording to the vinyl.
Few labels released a DVD edition of the symphony after the format declined.
My older player reads MP3 files but cannot handle the newest Blu-ray discs.
Children diagnosed with diabetes usually need lifelong care from an endocrinologist.
Researchers traced the illness to mutations in a single gene on chromosome 21.
Workers coated the drill bits by a process known as plating at low temperature.
The clinic treats common immune disorders such as asthma and HIV in young patients.
Engineers replaced the old panel with a cheaper USB model instead of a VGA module.

notes: Probes: SACD 0.76, APECED 0.32; common whole acronyms (DVD, NASA, FBI) under 0.02, and AEDs and EFI were also low. Very sparse pole in a gate-closed leak regime. Three fire items try other rare acronyms ending in D; whether they split is untested.
